plan.title: fix(triage): worktrees-probe case-fold sibling unregister flake recurred on 0.124.0 tip (post-#5460)

narratives.Description: Harden evaluator worktree prune so a stale or failed case-sensitivity signal cannot unregister a case-distinct sibling admin entry (0.124.0 tip flake recurrence after #5460).
narratives.Overview:
## Bound remedy

1. **On-disk recorded worktree gate.** In pruneEvaluatorWorktreeAdmin, when the recorded worktree path still exists on disk and its realpath basename is case-distinct from the removal target, refuse to unregister that admin entry even if canonicalize previously folded.

2. **Missing-path canonicalize uses bypassCache.** canonicalizeWorktreePath must not lowercase a missing leaf from a stale caseInsensitiveDirCache true; probe with bypassCache (or treat as case-sensitive on probe failure).

3. **Stale-cache regression test.** worktrees-probe.test.ts seeds a stale true cache (or equivalent) and proves aaa survives under denied containedWrite; assert realpath of Wt-Eval !== wt-eval before acting.

4. **CHANGELOG.** Unreleased Fixed bullet for #5519 (post-#5460 recurrence).

Refs Prefer-A Bound for release-blocking tip flake class.
